changes: pads: none → pads (groove_mm 3, lip_mm 0, pad_angle_deg 0, pad_tpu_mm 2, reach_mm 15, width_mm 20)
why: The pads cost $0 and 16 machine minutes (m2 screws on hand, 2 g PLA, 1 g TPU), so pairing them with the slide hedges the rolling-object risk of proposal 1 and targets the two failures the slide alone does not touch. 15 mm of reach leaves table clearance for the 17 mm dice, since System 1 sets grasp height. A 3 mm groove centres 42-75 mm spheres without wedging flat boxes, because flat faces still meet the groove lands. Total cost $5.40, 3 days, 176 machine minutes.

The record isolates reach. Prismatic with no pads (reach 0) gained apple and potted meat can. Pads with reach 5 on the stock hinge jaw gained apple. Pads with reach 15 lose both. Going back to reach 5 keeps the groove (centres the rolling plum and strawberry) and the TPU (friction 0.9, gained mustard and screwdriver), which are the pad features that held the extra groups. Settings only: $0 and about 16 machine min, so no swap or purchase is needed.
